simple.meaning: מַחֲלֶה (machăleh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “sickness.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 15:26. The surrounding context includes family line, commandment, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחֲלֶה (H4245) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַחֲלֶה (machăleh) / H4245 is traced through Exodus 15:26, Exodus 23:25, 1 Kings 8:37, 2 Chronicles 6:28 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you, which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”
You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

“If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities; whatever plague, whatever sickness there is;

“If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is;
and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’ ”
A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness,

definitions.full: H4245. machaleh [ מַחֲלֶה ] noun [masculine] sickness, disease — suffix מַחֲלֵהוּ Prov 18:14 his sickness (= any sickness of his); of specific disease, construct מֵעֶ֑יךָ מַחֲלֵה 2Chr 21:15 (+ מֵהַחֹ֑לִי רַבִּים, בָּחֲלָיִים ). מַחֲלָה noun feminine sickness, disease , מַחֲלָה Exod 15:26 3 t. — sickness, disease , (in General) 23:25 (JE); so with כל , 1Kin 8:37 2Chr 6:28 (|| כלנֶֿגַע ), Exod 15:26 (J E; compare רֹפְאֶ֑ךָ יהוה אני near the end)
